description: Two OSM historic=aircraft nodes 30 m apart on the Kabul airport perimeter plus one undated user-submitted satellite spot describing "a MiG on static display". The type is reported only as "a MiG" — which of the MiG-15; MiG-17; MiG-19; MiG-21 or MiG-23 Afghanistan operated is not established; recorded as unidentified rather than guessed. Presence after 2021 is unverified
Second OSM node of the pair; no type; no name; no date. Recorded so the count is not silently understated
